video.title: Training Programs Without the Price Tag
video.script: You're charging what. 50 a session. But your client management tool costs 80 a month. That's broken math. This lets you build workout programs from templates, customize them for each client, share a link. They log their reps and sets. You see what they completed and write a check-in note. No per-seat pricing. No hidden tiers. Works for solo trainers and small groups. Link is in the description.
